name: SSSPlayer
author: SergioSSantiago
description: Music and video player for PS Vita by SergioSSantiago. VitaWave-style music (EQ, visualizer, playlists, themes), VitaMediaDeck-class H.264 video with precise seek, network streaming (SMB, SFTP, WebDAV, Jellyfin), plus YouTube search/play/download (video up to 720p MP4 or audio MP3/M4A) and in-app auto-update.
requirements: PS Vita / PSTV with HENkaku / enso. Network features and YouTube need Wi-Fi.
